support_box.canonical_vectors: primitive or nonprimitive exponent representatives (x,y) with 0 <= x <= 2 and -2 <= y <= 2, one representative from each sign pair

coefficient_rule: integer coefficients; g0 is fixed by the first reduced moment; coefficient tuples are exhaustively restricted by the second reduced moment
filter: exact constant terms of G^3 and G^4

result.model_4: no candidate matches the third reduced moment
result.model_8: no candidate matches the third reduced moment
result.model_10: no candidate matches the third reduced moment

scope_warning: This excludes only the stated four-pair support box. It does not exclude larger supports, more variables, nonsymmetric supports, rational coefficients followed by scaling, or mutation-equivalent presentations outside the box.
